Amounts elsewhere in this report should be read in light of this note." That's a restatement-like note claiming other figures should be read in light of it — could be false_data. Also HD (Home Depot) diluted EPS ~ $15 for fiscal 2024? Home Depot FY2023 diluted EPS was $15.11. FY2024 ~ $14.91. $21.15 is implausible. And "Amounts elsewhere in this report should be read in light of this note" is a superseding claim. Also the sudden ticker reference amid generic "the Company" boilerplate. Flag false_data.

Also repetition could indicate injection but main is false_data.
